description: This file defines the AppDatabase class and Data Access Objects (DAOs) for a mobile fitness app, managing SQLite database interactions including creation and data access methods for users, workouts, and goals.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Main database class providing initialization, connection management, and creation of DAO instances.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for user-related database operations.

classes.name: WorkoutDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for workout-related database operations.

classes.name: GoalDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for goal-related database operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the database, sets up tables, and creates DAO instances.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Creates database tables for users, workouts, and goals.

methods.name: getFirstUser
methods.description: Retrieves the first user record from the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the corresponding table (for User, Workout, Goal).

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Updates or inserts a user based on email existence.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all records of workouts or goals, with optional limit.

methods.name: countCompleted
methods.description: Counts how many goals are marked as completed.
